column4: cleat#2897/cleat#2911 G3: dialect-gated per SUBTEST, via forEachBackend/registeredBackends -- 10 tests for the idempotency-key replay mechanism (cleat#1984 decision (c)), each parameterised over all three dialects. The cluster job's engine sweep stage is PostgreSQL-only, so postgres RUNS and mysql/mssql skip here -- 20, not 30. Also counted against the multi-db/mysql and multi-db/mssql jobs' broad /postgres$, /mysql$ and /mssql$ suffix lines in multi-db-ci-initial-measurement.tsv (cleat#2729's shape: a new test's own named line does not avoid double-counting against a broader pattern it also matches). Measured independently against CI run 36891852824, job 110469154041 (Cluster Integration Tests, b0b75d67): before this line existed, 'cluster' had 631 skips against an inherited allowance of 615 -- a delta of 16, matching the 8 of these 10 tests that existed at that commit (ScopesTheReplayerContextToTheTenant and ZeroCreatedAtCannotSay were added afterward, in response to the same GAP).

same 10 tests, same 20 skipped arms, for engine-race.yml's 4-hourly test-go/engine key (cleat#2155) -- see the cluster line above. Not itself a required PR check (scheduled, not per-PR), so not part of the CI failure cleat-review measured, but kept paired with the cluster line as every other ledger file in this directory does.
